spans.s: Vṛddhi form of निः (for निस्) in comp.
नैः—श्रेयस mf(ई)n. leading to happiness or future beatitude, Mn. (˚सिक, xii, 88), MBh.
नैः—श्रेयस n. N. of a wood in the world of Viṣṇu, BhP.
नैः—सङ्ग्य n. absence of attachment, indifference, Jātakam.
नैः—सर्गिक mfn. cast off, put off, Divyāv.
N. of partic. transgressions punished with the confiscation of something belonging to the transgressor, Buddh.
नैः—स्नेह्य n. absence of love or affection, Mn. ix, 15.
नैः—स्पृह्य n. absence of longing for anything, Kāv.
नैः—स्व्य n. (fr. निह्-स्व) absence of property, destitution, poverty, Var.
